purpose: Keep generic monster PvE separate from Wanted Codes because ordinary monsters can attack and therefore survivability and frontline placement matter.

rules.frontlineRule: When Defense-role heroes are present, fill as many of the two frontline slots with them as possible before comparing offensive output.
rules.noFakeCompositePower: Do not add ATK + DEF + HP or reuse displayed Power. Offense and survival remain separate dimensions until the damage/mitigation model is calibrated.
rules.positionSearch: Evaluate all 120 placements for five heroes because monster-specific row effects can conflict with ordinary front/back role placement.
